Class FightController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<FightView>
controllers.fight.FightController
All Implemented Interfaces:
FightListener
public class FightController extends Controller<FightView> implements FightListener
Controller for the fight screen.

Orchestrates the turn-based combat loop between the player and the enemy: handles attack selection, enemy AI reaction, on-field Bugémon switches, and delegates all visual updates to FightView.

Implements FightListener so that FightView can forward user actions without holding a direct reference to this class.

      public void onAttackSelected(int attackIndex)
      Called when the player selects an attack. Triggers the player's attack, then schedules the enemy's counterattack after ENEMY_REACT_TIME seconds. Checks if the battle is over after the player's attack.
